translation: Pallavi: Jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; the people move for Telangana, the battle moves for Telangana; the people move for Telangana, the battle moves for Telangana; shouting jai let's raise the flag, joining hands let's sing the song; shouting jai let's raise the flag, joining hands let's dance the dance; shouting jai let's raise the flag, joining hands let's sing the song; shouting jai let's raise the flag, joining hands let's dance the dance
Jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go

Verse 1: They plundered and sifted through all our lush green villages - plundered and sifted through all our lush green villages; they dried up all the rushing streams of water into a desert - dried them up into a desert; with the whip they lashed and lashed, leaving wounds that never heal - lashed and lashed, leaving wounds that never heal; they ate up Telangana like a ripe melon and threw away the peel - ate it up and threw away the peel; enough of this game of tricks and deceit... played by the landlord-masters of coastal Andhra
Jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go

Verse 2: Even the drinking-gruel between the Krishna and Godavari rivers has grown scarce - has grown scarce; in the name of dense forests they kept even firewood twigs beyond our reach - kept it beyond our reach; digging coal through open-cast mining they turned every village into a pit - turned every village into a pit; swallowing our coal and water, the power companies brought darkness down on our very heads - brought darkness down on our heads; we will not stand for this deceit and these conspiracies... let's unite and resist...
Jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go

Verse 3: This backwardness is no curse, it is the sin of the Andhra rulers; O young men whose blood is boiling, O young women brimming with strength; O oppressed ones denied an education, O sufferers who cannot find work; O oppressed ones denied an education, O sufferers who cannot find work; O workers of shuttered factories, O farmers who lost their land; O people of this region who were sacrificed to discrimination under united Andhra Pradesh... shedding blood for Telangana... salute the martyrs who gave up their lives and take up the flag... cross every peril and march on...
Jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go

Verse 4: For the tiller to get his rightful share, for water to soak the ploughed furrows; for the tiller to get his rightful share, for water to soak the ploughed furrows; for a working life free of shutdowns and layoffs; for a working life free of shutdowns and layoffs; for people's rights where oppression and exploitation are unseen; for people's rights where oppression and exploitation are unseen; for a language and dialect free of insult and injustice; for a language and dialect free of insult and injustice; walk the road toward winning the power of a people's Telangana...

Jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; the people move for Telangana, the battle moves for Telangana; shouting jai let's raise the flag, joining hands let's sing the song; shouting jai let's raise the flag, joining hands let's dance the dance; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go; jai jai Telangana, let's go, jaira Telangana, let's go
summaryEn: Classified as a Movement song, this is a direct call-to-march anthem for the Telangana statehood cause, from Vimalakka's 2023 album 'Vimalakka Hits'. The pallavi is a rousing chant urging people to raise the flag, sing and dance their way into the struggle. Each verse then lays out specific grievances used to justify the movement: the plunder of Telangana's villages and the drying up of its water resources; the exploitation of its forests and coal through open-cast mining that leaves villages as pits and power companies profiting while locals are left in darkness; systemic backwardness blamed squarely on the rulers of united Andhra Pradesh, addressed to angry youth, the uneducated, the jobless, retrenched workers and dispossessed farmers who suffered discrimination; and finally a set of positive demands - land rights for the tiller, secure jobs, freedom from oppression, and dignity for the Telangana language and dialect. The song is explicitly political and economic in its argument rather than devotional or narrative, using the refrain as a rhythmic rallying cry between successive charges against 'Andhra Kosta dorababulu' (the landlord elite of coastal Andhra).
summaryTe: ఉద్యమ గీతంగా వర్గీకరించిన ఈ పాట తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర ఏర్పాటు ఉద్యమం కోసం నేరుగా పిలుపునిచ్చే ఒక ఉత్తేజకర గీతం - వైమలక్క 2023 ఆల్బమ్ 'వైమలక్క హిట్స్'లోనిది. పల్లవి జెండా ఎత్తి, పాటలు పాడుతూ, ఆటలాడుతూ ఉద్యమంలో పాల్గొనమని ప్రజలను ప్రేరేపిస్తుంది. ప్రతి చరణం ఉద్యమానికి కారణమైన నిర్దిష్ట ఫిర్యాదులను వివరిస్తుంది - తెలంగాణ పల్లెల దోపిడీ, నీటివనరులు ఎండిపోవడం; ఓపెన్ కాస్ట్ మైనింగ్ ద్వారా అడవులు, బొగ్గు వనరుల దోపిడీ, గ్రామాలు గుంతలుగా మారడం, కరెంటు కంపెనీలు లాభపడుతూ స్థానికులు చీకటిలో మిగలడం; సమైక్య ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ పాలకుల వల్ల ఏర్పడిన వెనుకబాటుతనం, కోపంతో ఉన్న యువత, చదువు అందని వారు, ఉద్యోగాలు లేనివారు, మూతపడిన కంపెనీల కార్మికులు, భూములు కోల్పోయిన రైతులు ఎదుర్కొన్న వివక్ష; చివరగా దున్నేవాడికి భూమి హక్కు, స్థిరమైన ఉద్యోగాలు, అణచివేత నుండి విముక్తి, తెలంగాణ భాష యాసకు గౌరవం వంటి సానుకూల డిమాండ్లు. ఈ పాట భక్తిగీతం లేదా కథాగీతం కాకుండా, స్పష్టంగా రాజకీయ, ఆర్థిక వాదనతో నిండి ఉంది, 'ఆంధ్రా కోస్తా దొరబాబుల' మీద వరుస ఆరోపణల మధ్య పల్లవిని లయబద్ధమైన నినాదంగా ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.
